description: Use this when a signed-in user wants a logo animated but has no logo yet, or asks for a new one: designing it with AI is the recommended first step of the logo path. Ask what the app's logo designer asks: the brand name (spelled exactly), and optionally what the brand does, the logo type, up to two feel words and up to three colours. Generates one flat logo on a plain background. Uses 1 credit from the user's balance (failed or refused attempts give it back). Usually ready in under a minute: this call waits briefly, then check with get_design, show the image and ask the user to check the spelling. Next step: start_motion with its design_id (or retry_design for another version). The user's own brand only: no well-known brands or real people. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

brand.description: The brand name, spelled exactly as it should appear.

logo_type.description: symbol = a symbol with the name (default); wordmark = the name only; lettermark = initials; mascot = a mascot badge.

what.description: Optional: what the brand does, in a few words.

name: design_logo

image_url.description: The finished image (PNG/WebP); the link works for 10 minutes.

name.description: The character description, or the brand name of a logo.

next_step.description: How to animate it: create_character_set (character) or start_motion (logo) with design_id.

title: Design a logo with AI
